_doc: keyteki `when: { onXxx: (event, context) => … }` keys → our Trigger. subject = the expression that names the card (or player) the event is about; the lambda is read against it with the filter library (lambdas.mjs). status: ok = lowered in M1; pending = recognised, lowered in M2 (patterns/events). Lote 15c: status ok = lowered (gatilhos que o MOTOR ja dispara: fire()/fireObservers()/wakePlayer em game.ts). turnBound = gatilho proprio do turno do controller (startOfTurn/endOfTurn); house = a escolha de casa (cond self+active). Os que ficam pending NAO tem evento no motor (engineGap do relatorio 15c): onUseCard, onDamageApplied, onDamageDealt, onStealAmber, onModifyAmber, onCardPlaced, onCardAttached, onCardLeavesPlay, onCardExalted, onCardStunned, onCardCaptured, onCardHealed, onCardReturnedToHand, onCardArchived, onAmberStolen, onPhaseEnded, onTurnEnd, onChooseHouse.

onChooseActiveHouse.notas: Lote 15c: literal da casa = casa impressa da propria carta (a gramatica do texto so le a casa propria); o filtro vira self+active.

onTurnStart.notas: Lote 15c: o motor so dispara no turno do controller — event.player === context.player e o default.
